name: update_checklist
title: Change the project startup checklist
description: Change the startup checklist, one op per call; your own tool, so no owner request is needed. Nothing is deleted: to override the owner, apply another template or set items to not_needed with a reason. The system keeps a conditional item done only while its condition holds.

op.description: init: the base list of a project that has none. add: a new item (title, optional hint and condition; its id is custom_<n>). edit: item_id with a new title and/or hint. set_condition: item_id and condition. set_state: item_id and state. apply_template: template_id adds the template items the list lacks and sets the base template; it overwrites nothing.

condition.description: null takes it off; a done item can get only a condition that holds.

state.description: done is refused while the item condition does not hold (checklist_condition_unmet).
